_readme: Edit this file to update the whole site — no coding needed. Prices are plain numbers (no currency symbol). Set 'mrp' equal to 'price' to hide the strikethrough/offer badge for that product. Image paths are relative to the site root (the images/ folder next to index.html) — drop your real photos in with these exact filenames, or change the paths to match your own files.

footerVideo.description: A short look at the hands, ingredients, and care behind every Organicabelle bar. (Sample video shown below — replace with your own brand footage.)

products.name: Neem Botanical Soap
products.desc: A grounding, earthy bar built around neem — the classic botanical of an everyday ritual.
products.about: Our Neem bar is cut and cured slowly, then wrapped by hand the same day it's cut, so the botanical character stays close to its source.
products.skinFeel: Clean, fresh, matte — never tight or stripped.
products.suitableFor: Everyday use; those who enjoy an earthy, herbal scent.
products.origin: Neem leaves are gathered from village trees near our workshop, then dried in the shade before use.
products.howToUse: Lather between wet hands or a washcloth, cleanse, then rinse well. Store on a draining dish between uses to help the bar last longer.
products.production: Leaves are washed, dried, and infused into the base before it's poured, cut into bars, and cured for several weeks.

journey.title: Into the forest
journey.text: Our journey begins at a neem tree at the edge of the village, its leaves catching the morning light.

journey.title: Gathering leaves
journey.text: Only what's needed is gathered by hand, leaf by leaf, leaving the tree undisturbed for next season.

journey.title: Washing & drying
journey.text: The leaves are washed, sorted, and laid out to dry slowly in the shade.

journey.title: Into the mixture
journey.text: Dried neem is infused into the soap base, then poured into simple wooden molds.

journey.title: A finished bar
journey.text: Days later, the mixture has become a firm bar — cut, cured, and wrapped in kraft paper and jute.

products.name: Aloe Vera Botanical Soap
products.desc: A soft, clean bar built around aloe — light, gentle, and easy to fold into a daily ritual.
products.about: Aloe's cooling, soft character comes through in a bar that's gentle enough for daily use, wrapped the traditional Organicabelle way.
benefits: A calm start or end to the day
products.suitableFor: Daily use; those who prefer a lighter, gentler bar.
products.origin: Aloe is cut from low, sun-hardy plants grown along the workshop's garden edge.
products.howToUse: Work into a light lather with warm water. Gentle enough for both morning and evening use.
products.production: Fresh aloe gel is separated from the leaf, blended into the base, poured, cut, and cured.

journey.title: Into the forest
journey.text: The path leads past a row of aloe plants, their thick leaves standing in the sun.

journey.title: Gathering aloe
journey.text: A few outer leaves are cut carefully, leaving the plant to keep growing.

journey.title: Extracting the gel
journey.text: The leaves are rinsed and the cooling gel is drawn out by hand.

journey.title: Into the mixture
journey.text: The gel is blended into the soap base and poured into molds.

journey.title: A finished bar
journey.text: Once cured, the bar is cut, wrapped in kraft paper, and tied with jute thread.

products.name: Rose Botanical Soap
products.desc: An elegant, romantic bar carrying rose's soft floral character — the most premium bar in the collection.
products.about: Rose petals inform both the scent and the soft rose-muted tone of this bar, wrapped with an extra fold of care.
products.suitableFor: Those who enjoy a romantic, floral daily ritual.
products.origin: Roses are picked at first light from a small garden plot, while the petals are still cool.
products.howToUse: Lather generously for a lightly fragrant wash; pat dry rather than rubbing to help the scent linger.
products.production: Petals are gently pressed for their extract, blended into the base, poured, cut, and cured.

journey.title: Into the forest
journey.text: The trail opens onto a small clearing where roses grow along a wooden fence.

journey.title: Gathering petals
journey.text: Petals are picked one by one, choosing only the fullest blooms.

journey.title: Pressing the petals
journey.text: The petals are gently pressed to draw out their soft floral extract.

journey.title: Into the mixture
journey.text: The rose extract is folded into the base and poured into molds.

journey.title: A finished bar
journey.text: The cured bar is cut, its muted rose tone visible, then wrapped by hand.

products.name: Charcoal Botanical Soap
products.desc: A modern, minimal bar with a deep matte tone — refined and understated, for a focused evening ritual.
products.about: Charcoal lends this bar its deep, minimal look, balanced with the same botanical base as the rest of the collection.
products.skinFeel: Smooth with a clean, refreshed finish.
products.suitableFor: An evening ritual; those drawn to a modern, minimal bar.
products.origin: Activated charcoal is sourced from slow-burned coconut shell, ground fine before use.
products.howToUse: Lather well for an evening cleanse; a slightly longer lather helps lift the day's grime.
products.production: Charcoal is sifted and blended into the base, poured, cut, and cured to a deep matte finish.

journey.title: Into the forest
journey.text: Past the garden, a quiet clearing holds baskets of dark, sifted charcoal.

journey.title: Gathering charcoal
journey.text: Fine activated charcoal is measured out by hand from slow-burned coconut shell.

journey.title: Sifting
journey.text: It's sifted twice more, so only the finest powder makes it into the mix.

journey.title: Into the mixture
journey.text: The charcoal is folded into the base until it turns a deep, even black.

journey.title: A finished bar
journey.text: The cured bar is cut to its matte charcoal finish, then wrapped by hand.

products.name: Lavender Botanical Soap
products.desc: A calm, refined bar carrying lavender's familiar, quieting character — well suited to an evening ritual.
products.about: Lavender stems inspire both the muted lavender tone and the calm, unhurried feel of this bar.
products.skinFeel: Soft, calm, gently soothing to the senses.
products.suitableFor: Evening rituals; those who enjoy a calming botanical scent.
products.origin: Lavender stems are cut from a small raised bed that catches the last of the afternoon sun.
products.howToUse: Best worked into a slow, unhurried lather as part of a wind-down evening routine.
products.production: Stems are dried, their extract drawn out and blended into the base, poured, cut, and cured.

journey.title: Into the forest
journey.text: A narrow path leads to a raised bed of lavender, swaying gently in the breeze.

journey.title: Gathering stems
journey.text: Stems are cut just above the woody base, chosen at their most fragrant.

journey.title: Drying slowly
journey.text: Bundled and hung to dry, the lavender's calming scent begins to concentrate.

journey.title: Into the mixture
journey.text: The dried extract is blended into the base and poured into molds.

journey.title: A finished bar
journey.text: The cured bar is cut, its soft lavender tone visible, then wrapped by hand.

products.name: Red Wine Botanical Soap
products.desc: A rich, sophisticated bar in deep burgundy — the most indulgent expression in the Organicabelle collection.
products.about: Grape-derived botanical extract gives this bar its rich burgundy tone and its place as the collection's most indulgent bar.
products.skinFeel: Rich lather with a smooth, cushioned finish.
products.suitableFor: Those who enjoy a bold, indulgent daily ritual.
products.origin: Grape skins are sourced from a nearby small orchard, saved after the season's pressing.
products.howToUse: Lather generously for a rich, cushioned wash — ideal as an indulgent weekend ritual.
products.production: Grape-derived extract is blended into the base for its deep burgundy tone, then poured, cut, and cured.

journey.title: Into the forest
journey.text: The path opens onto a small orchard, heavy with grapes at the edge of harvest.

journey.title: Gathering grapes
journey.text: Grape skins, saved from the season's pressing, are collected in a woven basket.

journey.title: Preparing the extract
journey.text: The skins are gently processed to draw out their rich burgundy color.

journey.title: Into the mixture
journey.text: The extract is folded into the base, deepening it to a royal burgundy.

journey.title: A finished bar
journey.text: The cured bar is cut to reveal its rich tone, then wrapped by hand.

reviews.name: Ananya Sharma (sample)
reviews.text: The neem soap feels very natural and has a mild herbal fragrance. I've been using it regularly and really like the texture — doesn't leave my skin feeling tight afterward.

reviews.name: Rahul Deshmukh (sample)
reviews.text: Good everyday bar. The scent is quite mild compared to what I expected from neem, but it lathers well and lasts a long time.

reviews.name: Priya Nair (sample)
reviews.text: Bought this as a gift and ended up keeping one for myself! The wrapping alone feels premium — kraft paper and jute thread, no plastic anywhere. The rose scent is subtle, not overpowering.

reviews.name: Meera Kulkarni (sample)
reviews.text: Lovely soap, smells beautiful without being too strong. Ordered on WhatsApp and it arrived well packed.

reviews.name: Rohan Mehta (sample)
reviews.text: Rich lather and a nice, deep colour. A bit pricier than the others in the range but feels worth it for how it looks and feels.

reviews.name: Kavita Iyer (sample)
reviews.text: Very gentle — I have sensitive skin and this is one of the few soaps that doesn't leave it feeling dry. Will reorder.

reviews.name: Sameer Joshi (sample)
reviews.text: Nice minimal look on the shelf. Cleans well without stripping my skin, though I wish the bar was a touch bigger for the price.

reviews.name: Divya Rao (sample)
reviews.text: This has become part of my night routine — the lavender scent is calming and not artificial-smelling at all. Packaging is beautiful too, I keep the jute thread!

_reviews_note: 'product' must match a product id above (neem, aloe, rose, charcoal, lavender, redwine). 'social.url' is optional — leave empty to hide the social icon on that review, or set it to '#' as a demo stand-in like above. Set 'placeholder' to false once it's a real review, and remove the '(sample)' tag from the name.
